terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: What you and Tracecart can expect from each other when you search, buy, have something sourced or ship with us.

sections.title: Your account
body: You need an account to place an order. Keep your email and phone number correct: we send everything about your orders by email, and couriers use your number to deliver.
You are responsible for what is done from your account.

sections.title: Prices
body: The price at checkout covers the item, delivery, customs duties and taxes. It is fixed when you order, and nothing is added at delivery.
Prices shown in another currency are approximate. You pay in the currency shown at checkout.

sections.title: Paying
body: You can pay online (mobile money or card) or in cash on delivery, where each is available for your order. Approved company accounts may also pay on invoice, and gift cards can be used where accepted.
An online payment holds your items for a limited time. If it isn't completed in that time, the order is cancelled.

sections.title: Delivery
body: Delivery dates are estimates. We tell you by email when an order moves or is delayed.
Goods crossing a border can be held by customs. Suggested customs codes are never binding: a customs authority decides.

sections.title: Sellers
body: Some products are sold by independent sellers. The product page says who sells each one, and "Verified" means we approved that seller.
Sellers are responsible for describing their products accurately.

sections.title: Will it fit?
body: We say a part fits only when that rests on evidence: a manufacturer document, an OEM cross-reference or a test by our staff. Anything else says "may fit": check it before you buy.

sections.title: Sourcing and freight
body: A freight estimate is indicative. A quote holds until the date shown on it.
When we find a product for you, nothing is ordered until you accept a quote.

sections.title: Returns and refunds
body: You can ask to return an item from your account, within the period shown on your order. We refund what you paid once the return is accepted.

sections.title: What you can't do
body: You may not use Tracecart for illegal, counterfeit or prohibited goods, to mislead anyone, or to interfere with the service. We may cancel orders or close accounts that do.

sections.title: Changes
body: We may update these terms. The version that applies to an order is the one in force when you place it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What we collect, why, and who else handles it.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Your account: name, email and phone number.
Your orders: delivery addresses, what you bought, and the status of your payments. We never see or store your card details or mobile money PIN.
What you send us: the words, photos and videos you search with, and the files you attach to a request.
If you sell or carry with us: your company's details, identity documents and payout account.

sections.title: Why
body: To run your account, deliver your orders, answer your requests, find the products you describe, prevent fraud and meet our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.title: Who else handles it
body: Clerk (sign-in), CinetPay (online payments), Supabase (stored files and backups), Hetzner (hosting), our email provider, and Sentry (error reports, without personal details).
When you search with words, photos or video, what you send goes to Anthropic and Voyage AI to understand it. Search terms may also go to Mindcase when we look for a product for you.
Couriers and partners get what they need to deliver, never what you paid.

sections.title: Cookies and this device
body: We use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your country, language and recently viewed products. Your comparison list stays on your device.

sections.title: How long
body: We keep your data while your account is open, and after that only as long as our legal and accounting obligations require.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, and you can turn off order progress emails or news in your account. Write to us using the details below.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: The quickest way to get help with an order is from the order itself.

sections.title: About an order
body: Open your order under Account, then Orders. It shows where the order is, and from there you can ask for a return.

sections.title: Selling, carrying or buying as a company
body: Apply from the Sell on Tracecart, Carry with Tracecart or Buy as a company pages. Each one says what we need from you.
